scope: Independent read-only review of A21-01 through A21-07 and the exact A22 implementation and verification paths

supplemental_scope.paths: All 33 implementation paths, all 3 verification-only paths, and .agents/customization-policy.json

final_review.criteria: A21-01 through A21-07 pass. Active-message deduplication, changed-content/source preservation, rejected/aborted/interval-skipped invalid-zone behavior, synchronous append and creation rollback, Intl cache refold, v7 cache compatibility, and approved docs/catalog scope are covered.
final_review.limits: Read-only review only; the reviewer did not edit files, run tests, or run generators.

findings: The Intl mismatch test did not prove current Intl reclassifies a durable prior validation success and clears a stale failure latch.
Creation rollback coverage did not include accepted unpublished preparation appends.
Entered and proposed invalid browser zones did not assert first-invalid and proposal input order.
SessionProjectionRegistry.register and service JSDoc omitted exact same-key stateVersion/cacheFingerprint compatibility.
review_history.resolution: Added durable success-to-error and error-to-success Intl refold coverage; added accepted preparation-append creation rollback coverage; asserted entered and proposed zone input order; documented exact stateVersion and optional cacheFingerprint equality and regenerated the catalog.

findings: Rejected decisions with invalid entered/proposed zones and positive-interval skipped refreshes with invalid entered zones lacked delayed-failure regressions.
Late-registration coverage spied on snapshotEvents but not eventAt.
review_history.resolution: Added rejected-decision and positive-interval invalid-zone tests and an eventAt spy.

findings: The already-aborted test still used valid zone data and would not catch derivation before the abort guard.
review_history.resolution: Added an already-aborted request test with an invalid entered zone.

findings: A21-01 lacked a behavioral regression proving an active durable identical user message suppresses an inbox duplicate while source-only and content-only differences preserve the inbox item.
review_history.resolution: Added all three active-message variants to the agent-instructions inbox synchronization tests.

limitations: The pre-existing dirty worktree is preserved; unrelated dirty paths are not attributed to A22.
Scoped verification does not clear the repository-wide state-check findings, aggregate documentation findings, canonical-metric limitation, external platform/provider lanes, or release qualification.
